content:
Manchester United sealed the arrival of Manuel Ugarte from Paris Saint-Germain in a deal worth €50m, with a further €10m possible in add-ons, as Erik ten Hag strengthened his midfield options before the close of the summer window.

The Uruguay international, 23, agreed a five-year deal with an option for an extra season. His arrival gives Ten Hag another senior defensive midfield choice alongside Casemiro, adding energy, aggression and ball-winning quality to a squad aiming to climb back among Europe’s leading sides.

Ugarte said joining United was an “incredible feeling” and described the club’s plans as “extremely exciting”. He added that he was ready to give everything for his new teammates and help the side compete for major honours again.

United’s sporting director, Dan Ashworth, said Ugarte had been one of the club’s key targets during the window, praising his intensity, character and suitability for the team’s long-term vision.

The signing marks another major step in United’s rebuild, with Ten Hag hoping Ugarte’s arrival will bring greater balance and resilience to the centre of the pitch as the club seeks a return to elite status. Any other questions?.
